messages:
ali: FYI — after the token rotation at 14:03 we saw a spike in full reconnects from our websocket clients. billing flagged ~120 new sessions in 5m. anyone seen similar?

toni: saw the alert. heap of short-lived sessions, many from the same IP blocks. console traces show clients doing "reconnect -> new session" instead of resume.

rick: quick log sample:
```
14:03:12 conn=c-42 auth=rotate v=1->v2 handshake: auth ok
14:03:13 client: resume header missing
14:03:13 server: respond 204 token-rotated
14:03:13 client: drop + reconnect fresh
14:03:14 billing: session-start acct=team-x
```

ella: interesting that server sends 204 instead of asking for resume proof. Old SDKs expect a 401 to trigger explicit token-refresh flow, new SDKs try to attach resume token inline. We have a mismatch.

ali: console UX problem: per-route p95 appears to jump because new session claim time is counted. CS is getting paged. We need a way to mark these auth-rotation reconns so dashboards can treat them differently.

toni: could we add a transient "resume_grace" lease on route-manager when auth rotates? if we keep the previous lease for 20-30s and accept a resume attempt (signed) we avoid allocation and billing.

rick: security check: any grace must verify proof-of-possession. propose: client includes prior-session-hmac header signed with old token secret. server validates and only allows reattach if IP and user-agent are within tolerance. prevents replay from different host.

ella: agree on HMAC. also we should add telemetry dims: auth_rotated=(true|false), resume_reused=(true|false), lease_kept_ms. This will let us filter and adjust p95 computation.

ali: short-term plan: 1) route-manager: support ephemeral keepalive leases for rotated-auth; 2) auth-svc: emit rotation event with session hint; 3) server: annotate traces and emit metric auth_rotate.reuses.

toni: can we gate behind ff? prefer opt-in for Dedicated tenants first. Also console should add a saved filter "auth-rotations" and a tiny panel showing reattach_success vs reattach_fail per region.

rick: i'll sketch the patch. rough API: POST /route-manager/v1/lease/keep {session_id, keep_ms, allowed_tokens:[v1,v2], resume_proof_required:true} then route-manager refuses normal claims while the lease is held.

ella: question about telemetry: when a client reattaches using resume, should we mark the call as "resume=true" and exclude the route-claim duration from per-request timing? if so, dashboards will show less noisy spikes.

ali: yes - annotate traces with claim_time_ms and resume=true/false and a flag auth_rotate=true when applicable. Console will then have an aggregation option to exclude claim_time_ms from latency calculations for resume=false events.

rick: security caveat from infra: if we accept old tokens for a short window, we must log the decision along with decision_reason and create an alert if rate of reuses spikes -> potential token leak.

toni: good call. CS wants a simple query to find affected customers. I'll add a tag "auth-rotation-impact" to each annotated trace and a saved alert that groups by acct id.

deploy-bot: starting canary: route-manager v3 (auth-rotation-lease) -> 3% traffic, tag=auth-rotate-lease-probe

deploy-bot: [32m0% canary initiated[0m rollout_id=rm-2026-03-23-02

ali: decent. what's ETA for telemetry wiring? SRE needs it before we widen rollout.

rick: patch coming in ~90m. includes unit tests for resume-proof HMAC and a small e2e harness simulating SDK v1 and v2 behaviors.

ella: i'll draft the console filter and a small explainer blurb so support knows how to run the query. also adding a visualization showing claim_time contribution to p95.

toni: I'll add a temporary suppression window for the session-count alert so we don't page on expected churn during the probe.

ali: next steps: ship canary, verify auth_rotate.reuses < 1% and billing spike resolved. If stable after 2h, increase to 25% and coordinate with CS.

rick: PR posted: https://git.internal/rn/route-manager/pulls/512 -- includes telemetry schema and feature flag. test trace ids: trc-1357, trc-2468.

ella: console draft link: https://console/internal/dashboards/rotations (wip). added saved query "auth-rotation-impact last 24h".

ali: thanks team. after we pass the 25% stage we'll add permanent dashboard panels and a short incident playbook note. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
